# Markdoc documents

Documents are Markdoc (plain Markdown is valid Markdoc) with front matter the assistant indexes: `title`, `about`, `tags`, `access`. Headings become the sections the assistant answers from, so write them as the questions people ask.

## Front matter and sections

A document with the fields the assistant reads.

```markdoc file=front-matter.md
---
title: Exporting a report
about: How to export a report as CSV or PDF, and what to do when an export fails.
tags: [reports, exports]
---

## Export a report

Open the report, choose Export, then CSV or PDF.

## When an export fails

Exports over 10,000 rows run in the background and arrive by email.
```

## A document restricted by role

The `access` front matter and the `{% access roles=[…] %}` tag keep a section for signed roles only.

```markdoc file=invoices.md
---
title: Invoices and payment methods
access: [billing, admin]
---

Invoices are under Settings, then Billing.

{% access roles=["owner"] %}

## Refunds over $1,000

Owners approve them from the invoice.

{% /access %}
```
